mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in UNRATE above 4.4% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as higher unemployment is associated with reduced consumer spending and corporate investment.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses 4.4% threshold but 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicates a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rising in the same month
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rising but 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals reduced policy tightness, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS decline does not produce significantly positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply) reflects robust production and inventory accumulation, fostering confidence in corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO upward trend does not correlate with positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS below 135,000 in a monthly period signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS falls below 135,000 but 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rates indicates escalating inflation concerns, tightening financial conditions, and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising in the same month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising but 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.4% is associated with reduced consumer confidence and delayed corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rise in post-shock recovery does not produce significantly positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05).
